protocol.sampler_options: cfg=1, top_k=1, top_p=0.75, g_seed=0; greedy uses argmax in upstream cached autoregressive entry; FP16
protocol.image_output: float RGB arithmetic mean [0,1], preceding PNG rounding and AdaIN
protocol.scale: whole unpadded native valid pixels, 255 DN full scale
protocol.aggregation: image means weighted equally, target contrast errors first averaged within image
protocol.weighted_background: all valid pixels except square 2-pixel dilation of all native targets
protocol.ring: square 2-pixel dilation of each native 8-connected target, valid excluding all native targets
